decision_rule.failure_action: primary mean D<=0 or material harm gives STOP_MAX_H10; primary benefit without reliability/integrity/safety gives INCONCLUSIVE_NO_PROMOTION; only all gates passing gives NARROW_GO. Do not rescue failure by switching to low-O, another horizon, a class slice, or an external score on the same pool
promote_candidate_only_if: class795 mean D is at least 0.10 normalized severity
the frozen one-sided primary test is <=0.05 and the prefix-bootstrap 95 percent lower bound is above zero
the frozen attempt-index gate has p>=0.01
clear-bad and semantic-preservation one-sided 95 percent safety bounds stay within a 5 percentage-point noninferiority margin
decision_rule.transfer_boundary: classes207 and 602 have only 16 prefixes each and are gross-harm sentinels, not powered benefit confirmations; no generic three-class claim is allowed

external_judge_boundary.allowed_external_secondary_metrics: FID/Inception/DINO/CLIP may be reported only after sealing and may never select a branch, prefix, threshold, or horizon
external_judge_boundary.attempt_index_gate: on the 96 class795 prefixes, Pearson chi-square of selected physical-attempt counts versus uniform must have p>=0.01; otherwise mark INCONCLUSIVE_NO_PROMOTION as an RNG/index artifact risk
external_judge_boundary.blind_defect_scale: 0=ordinary for this frozen model, 1=obviously below the model's ordinary level because of blur/fusion/misalignment, 2=severe or catastrophic clear-bad; do not penalize mild ordinary model imperfections
external_judge_boundary.judges: three fresh isolated blind reviewers after frozen anchor qualification; consensus ordinal severity is the median of the three 0/1/2 votes, preservation is 2-of-3 yes, and consensus plus each reviewer are reported
external_judge_boundary.primary_comparison: blind absolute defect severity of max-A versus the exact uniform-random policy value over the same four already-computed scouts
external_judge_boundary.primary_estimand: D_i=mean_m L_im-L_i,max on class795, where L is consensus defect severity divided by two; positive is better
external_judge_boundary.primary_population: the 96 frozen class795 prefixes; no posthoc bad-prefix filter
external_judge_boundary.primary_test: within-prefix branch-label randomization: independently permute the four frozen external severities within each class795 prefix, recompute mean D, use 1000000 Monte Carlo permutations with seed 2026082807 and the plus-one one-sided p-value; prefix percentile bootstrap uses 100000 replicates with seed 2026082808 and [0.025,0.975] quantiles
external_judge_boundary.reliability_gate: anchor accuracy at least 80 percent for every reviewer, at least 95 percent valid votes for every reviewer, and the minimum of the three pairwise quadratic-weighted kappas at least 0.3; otherwise INCONCLUSIVE
safety: new severe blur, fusion, topology, limb/object attachment, displacement, count, pose, or composition error
harm among prefixes whose attempt0 is not clear-bad
external_judge_boundary.safety_estimands: obvious-bad is consensus severity>=1; catastrophic is severity=2. Compare selected max-A to the exact four-scout uniform-policy expectation. Use 100000 prefix bootstrap replicates with seed 2026082809 and require the one-sided 95 percent upper bound on obvious-bad excess <=0.05 and on preservation loss <=0.05, both in all class795 prefixes and sentinel-good prefixes whose independent attempt0 severity is 0
secondary_comparisons: a frozen realized hash-random slot for win/tie/loss intuition only
repair of blur, fusion, topology, limb/object attachment, or displacement when attempt0 is independently judged a clear opportunity

method.anonymous_slot_rule: map physical attempts 1..4 to anonymous slots A..D by a frozen per-prefix SHA256 permutation before computing any tie break or external mapping
method.equal_compute_control: one of the same four scouts selected by a frozen uniform hash independent of arrays and images
method.important_interpretation: A_m is a relative branch-geometry rank, not a probability of image quality and not an anytime-valid p-value
method.primary_horizon_timing: index 0 is the common prediction before the first fresh step149 innovation; index 10 is the prediction after exactly ten fresh P transitions
method.tie_break: smallest anonymous slot under the frozen per-prefix permutation, never physical attempt index or endpoint quality

outputs.operational_budget_statement: four scouts to h10 and only the selected scout beyond h10; running all four to endpoint here is evaluation overhead

pool.boundary: existing prefixes may have appeared in historical review products; only the new suffix draws and their branch-selection test are prospective

selection.algorithm: sort eligible (seed,class,step149) tuples by SHA256(salt|seed|class|step), greedily accept only if the class quota is open and the global seed is unused; class795 is the only confirmatory stratum because the motivating posthoc effect was concentrated there, while classes207/602 are gross-harm sentinels
forbidden_inputs: FID, Inception, DINO, CLIP, or any external embedding
